(JavaScript, VmfHelp.machineOutcome). Every page and report that counts
migrated machines asks one of them. If the two ever disagree, the Reports
page and the Migrations page show different numbers for the same run -
which is how REPORT-RESTORED-1 was found.
So this is the one list of cases, and both are held to it:
FINISH-COUNT-1: a machine with a swapPending record waits for a person,
whatever its state says, except while a wave worker still runs its step.
RUN-SUMMARY-SWAP-1: waitsOnPerson says which outcome waits for a person

summary.waitsOnPerson, which the overview and the migrations list read.
